senses.gloss:
तुखाराः, तुक्खाराः, तुःखाराः /tukhārāḥ/ /tukkhārāḥ/ /tuḥkhārāḥ/ 

Tukhārāḥ, Tukkhārāḥ, Tuḥkhārāḥ m. plur. die Tocharer | the Tokharians, auch Tokṣāra- (BSOAS 13, 404); gr. Tóxagoi, chines. Tu-huo-lo, usw.
Ausführlich zum Tocharernamen: Henning, BSOS 9, 545ff.; vgl. auch Bailey, BSOAS 15, 536.

तुखाराः /tukhārāḥ/ 

Tukhārāh : Vgl. zur Problematik des Tocharernamens noch
Haloun, ZDMG 91 (1937) 243ff., Henning, Asia Major N. S. 1 (1949) 158 ff., Bailey, BSOS 8 (1936) 883ff., TPS 1947, 152f.
